issues.description: Farm.addAnimal has inconsistent return types: the UML diagram specifies `addAnimal(animal: Animal): boolean`, but the provided solution implements `public void addAnimal(Animal animal)`. Students following the UML may implement a boolean-returning method that does not match the expected signature in the reference implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Align UML/spec and code to one signature. Prefer changing code to `public boolean addAnimal(Animal animal) { return animals.add(animal); }` (and update any callers accordingly), or update the UML/spec to `addAnimal(...): void` if no return value is intended.
